title: Place or role?
hook: A species can be described by where it lives and how it uses resources.

knows: Animals interact with other organisms and their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: A frog lives in a pond and eats insects at night. Which description is a part of its ecological role rather than the place?

misconception: One observation or model rule gives a complete answer about nature.
objective: A frog lives in a pond and eats insects at night. Which description is a part of its ecological role rather than the place?

claims.text: A frog lives in a pond and eats insects at night. Which description is a part of its ecological role rather than the place? The pond identifies the stipulated habitat; feeding on insects at night describes one aspect of how the frog uses resources. A full niche includes more than this one behavior.
claims.source: Unverified reference lead for independent check: OpenStax Biology 2e, ecology and populations, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e . Exact claim-specific sources have not been verified.

claims.text: The panels depict a simplified illustrative scenario, not observations or measurements of real animals.
A bird nests in a woodland and eats seeds there. Which phrase describes resource use? Eating seeds is resource use, while woodland identifies a place.
